query: select fp.team, latest.payload->'vc'->>'label' as "label?", case fp.team when 'red' then latest.payload->'vc'->>'red_channel_id' when 'blue' then latest.payload->'vc'->>'blue_channel_id' end as "channel_id?" from formation_players fp left join lateral ( select e.payload from formation_events e where e.formation_id = fp.formation_id and e.kind = 'vc_assigned' and e.payload ? 'vc' order by e.id desc limit 1 ) latest on true where fp.formation_id = $1 and fp.player_id = $2
